title: One feature folder, four colocated files per component
statement: Every component ships as a feature folder containing exactly `<name>.ts`, `<name>.html`, `<name>.css`, and `<name>.spec.ts`; templates and styles use `templateUrl`/`styleUrl`, never inline `template`/`styles` strings past a couple of lines, and component logic does not spread into unrelated folders.
rationale: Colocation is what makes 'enter anywhere (project -> subproject -> folder -> file)' code browsing (the product's stated core interaction) actually work: a reviewer opens one folder and sees the whole unit. Inline templates turn a `.ts` file into an unreviewable string blob with no template-language tooling, and logic split across folders defeats the folder-first navigation model.

bad.caption: Template and styles inlined as large strings instead of colocated files.

changelog.summary: Initial rule, grounded in the existing frontend/src/app feature-folder layout.
